cases.name: Milenna Eileen Lopez
cases.about: She was the general manager of a McDonald's restaurant on Detroit Road in Sheffield and was set to graduate from Lorain County Joint Vocational School as a dental assistant in February 2022.
cases.narrative:
She was shot and killed while sitting in her car outside of place of employment at McDonald’s in Sheffield Village.

She was on a break from work when detectives suspect he waited for her to come outside, approached her car, exchanged words and then allegedly shot and killed her.
